summary: Tested Partial Quoting feature for OEMLinker. Backend APIs fully functional - POST /api/vendor/quotation/itemwise accepts partial items, returns is_partial/quoted_items_count/total_rfq_items fields. GET /api/rfq/{rfq_id}/quotations returns partial_quotes count in comparison_summary. Frontend shows partial quote indicator text but QuotationComparison component uses simplified card view instead of table with badges.

minor.issue: Response uses 'items_count' instead of 'quoted_items_count' for consistency with GET endpoint

issues: Partial quote indicator shows as text ('Partial quote - only quoting selected items') instead of badge with count (e.g., 'Partial (2/4)')
QuotationComparison.jsx has badge implementation but buyer RFQ detail page uses different quote card component

action_items: Consider using QuotationComparison component in buyer RFQ detail page for consistent partial quote badge display
Minor: Align response field name 'items_count' to 'quoted_items_count' in POST /api/vendor/quotation/itemwise for consistency
critical_code_review_comments: Backend partial quoting logic is correctly implemented - validates items, calculates is_partial based on quoted vs total items
GET /api/rfq/{rfq_id}/quotations correctly returns partial_quotes count in comparison_summary
VendorQuotationForm.jsx has Select All/Deselect All buttons and item checkboxes for partial selection
QuotationComparison.jsx has AlertTriangle icon and 'Partial (X/Y)' badge implementation
Buyer RFQ detail page shows partial quote text indicator but doesn't use the badge format from QuotationComparison

success_rate.frontend: 85% - Partial quoting works, UI shows text indicator instead of badge

seed_data_creation: Used existing test RFQs: rfq_partial_test_1fa917f6 (3 items), rfq_partial_ui_test_dadab1 (4 items with partial quote from ABC Manufacturing - 2/4 items quoted)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Partial quoting feature is fully functional. Test RFQ 'rfq_partial_ui_test_dadab1' has a partial quote (2/4 items) from ABC Manufacturing for ₹3,200. Backend returns is_partial, quoted_items_count, total_rfq_items fields. VendorQuotationForm has item selection checkboxes. QuotationComparison has badge implementation but buyer RFQ detail uses card view with text indicator.
